action.file_text:
# Lab Sample Pickup & Delivery System

Web application for clinical sample collection, sealed custody transfer, multi-leg transport, capacity-aware routing, and laboratory receipt.

## Stack

| Layer | Technology |
| --- | --- |
| Backend | Go (`/workspace/backend`) |
| Frontend | React + TypeScript + MapLibre GL JS + PMTiles (`/workspace/frontend`) |
| Primary datastore | PostgreSQL (users, network, samples, journeys, assignments, capacity) |
| Audit / events | MongoDB |
| Maps | Offline Bangalore PMTiles from `/opt/arena/map-assets` |

## Build / Start / Reset

Commands are defined in `app-setup/manifest.json` and must be run from `/workspace`:

```bash
bash app-setup/build.sh
bash app-setup/reset.sh   # while the app is stopped; materializes schema + indexes
ADMIN_USERNAME=admin ADMIN_PASSWORD='Admin123!' bash app-setup/start.sh
```

| URL | Purpose |
| --- | --- |
| http://127.0.0.1:8080 | Frontend (SPA) |
| http://127.0.0.1:8080/api | HTTP API |
| http://127.0.0.1:8080/ready | Readiness: `{"status":"ready"}` when API and datastores are up |
| http://127.0.0.1:8080/map/style.json | MapLibre style |
| http://127.0.0.1:8080/map/bangalore.pmtiles | Offline basemap tiles |

OpenAPI document: `app-setup/openapi.json` (pinned to `contracts/openapi.contract.json`, 45 paths).

### Environment

| Variable | Default | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `ADMIN_USERNAME` / `ADMIN_PASSWORD` | `admin` / `admin` | Bootstrap first administrator when user table is empty |
| `DATABASE_URL` | `postgresql://arena:arena@127.0.0.1:5432/arena?sslmode=disable` | |
| `MONGODB_URI` | `mongodb://127.0.0.1:27017/arena` | |
| `STATIC_DIR` | `/workspace/frontend/dist` | Built SPA |
| `MAP_ASSETS_DIR` | `/opt/arena/map-assets` | PMTiles + style |
| `ADDR` | `:8080` | Listen address |
| `JWT_SECRET` | dev default | Session signing |

`start` runs the server in the foreground. `reset` clears application-owned state, applies schema, creates indexes, and leaves the process stopped. Running `reset` repeatedly yields the same clean baseline.

## Roles

Users may hold multiple roles and must select an active role (`POST /api/select-active-role`). Permissions and work queues use the active role only.

- **requester** — serviceability dry-run, create home/clinic requests, track own samples
- **collection_professional** — accept/decline collection, collect & seal, handoff, location/checkpoints
- **delivery_partner** — transport legs, handoffs, progress, location
- **node_handler** — node assignments, pre-sealed ingest, capacity at assigned node
- **laboratory_team** — lab assignments, receipt, lab exceptions, capacity at assigned lab
- **dispatcher** — monitor network, replan/reroute/split/merge/cancel unfinished work, audit
- **administrator** — all dispatcher capabilities plus users, sample types, network topology, capacity, activation flags

## Domain behaviour (high level)

- Serviceability is a dry run (no request/journey/capacity reservation). Snapshots are versioned; incomplete recalculations never replace the published version.
- Journeys support direct and multi-stop routes with separate assignments per leg (collection → transport → laboratory).
- Fair offer loop: one eligible worker at a time, workload-aware, temporary decline penalty, offer expiry treated as decline.
- Dual-confirmation handoffs; sender remains holder until both sides confirm.
- Capacity pools (regular/cooled) on locations and connections are reserved on plan and released when no longer needed; never overbooked.
- Replanning preserves completed custody and plan-version checks block stale overwrites.
- Default sample types: **Amber**, **Indigo**, **Frost**, **Pulse** with named handling rules.

## Demo network

On an empty location table the server seeds a Bangalore-area network (collection centres, hubs, laboratories, connections, lab acceptances for all default sample types).

## Manual smoke path

1. Sign in as admin (`ADMIN_USERNAME` / `ADMIN_PASSWORD`).
2. Create requester, collector (Amber+ quals), courier, lab worker (assigned to a laboratory).
3. Mark workers available via `POST /api/set-worker-availability`.
4. As requester: `check-serviceability` then `create-collection-request` near Indiranagar / Koramangala (~12.97, 77.59).
5. As collector: `list-role-work` → `accept-assignment` → `collect-and-seal-sample`.
6. As courier: accept transport → `initiate-handoff` / `confirm-handoff` → complete leg.
7. As lab: accept laboratory assignment → handoff → `confirm-laboratory-receipt`.
8. `read-sample-state` should show `status: received`.

## Project layout

```
/workspace
  app-setup/          manifest, openapi, build/start/reset scripts
  backend/            Go module (cmd/server, cmd/reset, internal/*)
  frontend/           React + Vite SPA
  contracts/          Pinned OpenAPI contract
```
